fallback_descriptions.scafctl-plugin-goscript: Yaegi-backed Go script provider for dynamic in-process script execution in scafctl.
fallback_descriptions.scafctl-plugin-smtp: SMTP email provider plugin for scafctl with STARTTLS encryption and authentication.
fallback_descriptions.scafctl-plugin-secret: Retrieves and lists encrypted secrets from the scafctl secrets store via HostService RPC.
fallback_descriptions.scafctl-plugin-auth-openshift: OpenShift authentication handler for scafctl supporting web OAuth and Entra ID.
fallback_descriptions.scafctl-plugin-oci: Daemonless OCI image provider — inspect, copy, build, mutate, and publish container artifacts.
fallback_descriptions.scafctl-plugin-kubeconfig: Kubeconfig and Kubernetes cluster configuration provider for scafctl.
fallback_descriptions.scafctl-plugin-cosign: In-process OCI artifact signing and verification provider powered by Cosign/Sigstore.
fallback_descriptions.scafctl-solution-plugin-template: Scaffolds a complete scafctl plugin repository with SDK wiring, tests, and release CI.
fallback_descriptions.event-reactor: Event-driven automation engine using CEL expressions to match events and dispatch reactions.
fallback_descriptions.go-flight: Generic singleflight library for Go with leader/follower execution and multi-tier caching.
fallback_descriptions.spiral-guard: Agent workflow guard that detects and interrupts repetitive failure spirals.
fallback_descriptions.kvbrowse: Lightweight CLI and interactive terminal browser for exploring nested YAML and JSON files.
fallback_descriptions.caddy-fs-gcs: Google Cloud Storage virtual filesystem module for Caddy.
